definitions.physical_block_share_allocated: sum physical_delivery_blocked / sum allocated, audit-leak gate convention
definitions.physical_block_share_alternative_deliver: sum physical_delivery_blocked / (sum delivered + sum physical_delivery_blocked), different denominator; NOT frozen gate
definitions.service_realization_over_funded: sum commodity_circuit.household_realized / sum commodity_circuit.household_funded by commodity over ticks 0..115; ratio of totals. NOT funded/desired or nominal household income.
definitions.expiry_tail_ratio: sum expired_services / sum production by commodity over ticks 106..115; ratio of totals, excludes initial stock expiry
definitions.production_liveness: sum production last 10 ticks / sum production first 10 ticks
